ActivityResponse.description:
One `activities` timeline row (B.2 `/companies/{id}/activities`).
`summary` carries non-sensitive labels, plus the current `body` for a
matching CRM note activity. Mail-derived rows never expose subject/body
here (§5.6, integration-contracts §activities).

linked_contact_ids.description: Other contacts already linked to this address (role addresses).

arguments_hash.description: SHA-256 hex 64자 (B.1.1 Hash 응답 형식; DB 저장은 BYTEA).

AgentRunBudget.description:
§13.5 비용 제한 필드 — 도구 호출 수·후보 수·외부 검색 수·입출력 토큰·비용
예산. 실제 공급자 과금이 없으므로 비용은 추정치다. B.2 target scope는
별도 `scope` 필드로 요청받고 `budget.target_scope` 안에 저장된다.

max_cost_usd.description: 추정 비용 상한 — 과금 자료가 없으므로 estimate로 해석한다 (§13.5).

AgentRunCancelResponse.description:
Cancellation makes the run stop accepting new actions; an external call
that already started is reported separately and may still finish.

AgentRunDetailResponse.description:
`GET /agent-runs/{id}` — run + 도구 호출 기록 (§13.5).
`agent_actions`는 hash·redacted 인자·결과 코드만 저장한다 — 원문·토큰·
모델 추론은 절대 저장하지 않는다.

AgentRunFinishOutcome.description: External agent-runner outcome. Clients cannot set any other run status.

budget.description: 상한 스냅샷(요청 시 검증된 키만 저장).

usage.description: 사용량 누적(도구 호출 수 등 — record_action이 갱신).

AgentRunStatus.description: `agent_runs.status` values, kept in sync with its DDL CHECK constraint.

AgentRunTargetScope.description: `POST /agent-runs` target-data scope. It filters work; it grants no access.

reauth_mailboxes.description: "OAuth 실패 반복" 계열 — 재인증 필요 메일함.

send_workers_locked.description: T30 복원 잠금 — true면 발송 워커가 잠겨 있어 대조 후 해제가 필요하다.

unknown_outbound.description: "unknown submission > 0" 알림 — 자동 재발송 금지, 대조만.

manifest_hash.description: The pinned snapshot/manifest hash, repeated for the approval UI.

policy_results.description: Current approval checks; unavailable checks are labeled explicitly.

retired_provider.description: True when the request is retained only as history because its delivery provider was retired.

snapshot.description:
Frozen mail snapshot, included only when the caller also has mailbox
`mail.read` authorization. Contents are the payload pinned by hash.

snapshot_hash.description: sha256 hex of the pinned snapshot.

target_id.description:
The concrete target FK value (launch / outbound / booking change /
suppression id) — exactly one exists per row.

ApprovalTargetSummary.description:
Non-sensitive target summary for `GET /approvals/{id}` (B.2 "동결
스냅샷·policy·권한"). Content-bearing fields are only present when the
caller holds a mailbox read grant on the target's mailbox (§5.6).

current_hash.description:
Recomputed hash of the live target — compared to `snapshot_hash` at
decision time (A.6.3).

mail_account_id.description:
The mailbox this target sends through, when mail-bound (launch /
outbound approvals).

preview.description:
Only with a mailbox read grant: launch → recipient/step counts,
outbound → to-address + subject.

status.description:
Current business status of the target row (launch status, outbound
status, booking_change status, or `active`/`released` for
suppressions). Absent when the target no longer resolves.

downloadable.description: false when the object is quarantined (`scan_status='rejected'`).

AuditLogEntry.description:
`GET /audit-logs` row — redacted 표현 (§5.6). `details`는 기록 시점에
allowlist로 작성되므로 본문·토큰을 포함하지 않는다.

host_principal_id.description:
Host the calendar belongs to. Defaults to the caller; setting
another principal requires Admin.

allowed_actions.description: UI hint only — the server re-checks every action (B.1.2).

CampaignStepInput.description:
Per-step definition inside a campaign (re)vision (B.3.6). `step_order` is
1-based, max 3 (DDL CHECK); `delay_hours` is relative to the previous
step's `accepted_at` (step 1 is relative to launch activation).

CancelOutboundRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/outbound-messages/{id}/cancel` — reason is optional and
recorded in the audit trail.

CancelOutboundResponse.description:
Minimal cancellation result for callers whose cancel permission does not
include permission to read the outbound body or recipient address.

ChangePasswordRequest.description:
`PUT /me/password`. Intentionally does not derive `Debug` so accidental
debug formatting cannot reveal either password.

Classification.description:
`email_messages.classification` — must equal the DDL CHECK values
(§12.4, §9.4).

ClassificationReviewRequest.description:
`POST /email-messages/{id}/classification-reviews` (B.2 — 분류·이유 →
검토·안전 중단). Human principals only.

reason.description: Human reviewer's reason — stored in audit metadata only (no column).

validation_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 returned by the validation job — pins the snapshot.

CompanyDuplicateCandidate.description:
Same-domain / same-name companies surfaced at create time (B.3.3) —
advisory only, never auto-merged.

ContactEmailItem.description: One `contact_emails` link joined with its `email_addresses` row.

linked_contact_ids.description: Other contacts linked to the same address (role addresses, §6.3).

scopes.description:
Intended scopes the agent's credentials may carry. Any known scope
is accepted, including `mail.send` and `mail.approve`.

agent_principal_id.description: run을 실행할 에이전트 principal id (kind='agent', active여야 한다).

oneOf.description: Target-data scope for the run (not an authorization grant).

CreateCampaignRequest.description:
`POST /campaigns` (B.3.6) — creates the campaign plus revision 1 and its
steps in one transaction.

blocking_reasons.description: B.5 code names that currently block operational sending.

channel_ready.description: true only when the delivery channel is enabled and policy-allowed.

CreateCommunicationBasisRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/communication-bases` — new basis, always stored `pending`
(B.2: "신규는 pending"). A human review transitions it later.

basis_type.description:
DDL CHECK: explicit_consent | requested_reply |
requested_transaction | reviewed_exception.

email.description: Optional primary email linked atomically with creation.

never_expires.description:
Issue a credential without a practical expiry (stored as a far-future
instant; revoke it to end access). Overrides `expires_in_days`.

CreateDecisionRequest.description:
`POST /approvals/{id}/decisions` (B.3.9) — requires If-Match on the
request version and an Idempotency-Key.

expected_snapshot_hash.description: sha256 hex of the snapshot the approver actually reviewed.

CreateDeliveryChannelRequest.description:
`POST /delivery-channels` (Admin). The channel's provider is taken from
the referenced `integration_connections` row.

sender_identity_id.description: Sender identity on that mail account.

expected_manifest_hash.description: sha256 hex of the manifest the caller reviewed.

tracking_requested.description:
Add recipient-bound request tracking capabilities when the workspace
has engagement tracking enabled. False by default at immutable freeze.

variables.description:
Allowed personalization values — applied to every recipient unless a
system-resolved variable of the same name exists (system wins).

agent_run_id.description: Owning agent run (optional; must exist in this workspace).

proposals.description:
Max 100 per request (§13.4). All-or-nothing: one invalid item fails
the whole batch with 422 (B.3.12).

thread_id.description: Reply linkage — all three are required together (DDL CHECK).

variables.description:
Template variable values. Keys must be declared in the version's
`variable_schema`; system variables may not be supplied.

visibility.description: "private" (default) | "mailbox" — shared drafts for the account team.

CreateNoteRequest.description:
`POST /notes` — exactly one of `company_id` / `contact_id` / `thread_id`
(DDL CHECK; validated as 400 before the DB sees it).

expected_payload_hash.description:
Must equal the outbound's current `payload_hash` — the approval is
bound to this exact snapshot.

CreateRevisionRequest.description: `POST /campaigns/{id}/revisions` — same shape minus the campaign fields.

explicit_follow_up.description:
Required to make a new draft after provider acceptance a deliberate
follow-up instead of a silent retry.

CreateSmtpConnectionRequest.description:
`POST /smtp-connections` — credential is accepted on write only.

Deliberately does not implement `Debug`: request bodies can contain a
password and should not be printed by handlers or diagnostics.

sender_confirmed.description:
Required administrator attestation that this sender address is a
registered sender or authorized alias.

CreateSuppressionRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/suppressions` — record a workspace-wide block
(B.2: "주소·목적·이유 → 차단"). Reaffirming an identical active
suppression is idempotent by design (§11.2).

reason.description: DDL CHECK: unsubscribe | complaint | hard_bounce | manual.

owner_principal_id.description:
Defaults to the requesting principal. Assigning another principal
requires Manager/Admin (owner reassignment is privileged, §5.3).

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over canonical content, 64-char lowercase hex.

byte_size.description:
Declared byte size, 1..=20MB (B.1.1). The actual upload may be
smaller; the stored size is what was received.

filename.description: Display name of the file (metadata only).

media_type.description:
Declared media type; must be one of the CSV types the validator
accepts (`text/csv`, `application/csv`, `application/vnd.ms-excel`).

CredentialCreatedResponse.description:
`201` response for credential creation — `secret` appears exactly once
and is never stored or replayed (hashed at rest).

secret.description:
`osk_…` bearer token — returned ONCE. Absent on idempotent replays
(the secret is never persisted for replay, B.1.3).

DashboardKpis.description:
§2.4 성공 지표 — 각 KPI의 정확한 SQL 정의는 `application::operations::dashboard`
의 한국어 주석을 따른다.

eligible_contacted_companies.description: 적격 접촉 기업 수 (기간 내 공급자 수락 메일의 고유 기업).

first_reply.description: 최초 답장 처리 시간 — 수신 관측~직원 회신 수락, 중앙값(초).

meeting_conversion.description: 유효 미팅 전환율 (유효 미팅이 열린 기업 / 적격 접촉 기업).

reply_company_ratio.description: 답장 기업 비율 (사람 답장 관측 기업 / 적격 접촉 기업).

DashboardSummaryResponse.description:
`GET /dashboard/summary` (B.2) — §2.4 KPI 정의 + cohort + freshness
(UI01: 분모·관측 기간·데이터 갱신 시각 표시, 모르는 값은 null=N/A).

generated_at.description: 응답 생성 시각 — 라이브 조회이며 캐시 스냅샷이 아니다.

operational.description: §2.4 "운영 안정성"은 각각 별도 모니터링 — 합산 점수로 만들지 않는다.

queues.description: Count-only work queues visible to this principal and dashboard scope.

DecisionResponse.description:
`POST /approvals/{id}/decisions` response (B.3.9). An approval records
permission only; outbound message execution must be explicitly submitted.
Other approval types may still enqueue their follow-up job.

execution_status.description:
`ready` when approval waits for explicit execution, `queued` when an
approval type enqueues its own follow-up, or `none` when rejected.

provider_accepted_count.description: Always 0 — a decision never means provider acceptance (B.3.9).

DisableRequestRequest.description:
`POST /principals/{id}/disable-requests` — reassignment + pending-work
policy for the async disable cleanup (A.7).

cancel_pending.description:
Cancel not-yet-dispatched work owned by the principal. Default true
(§5.5 — credential revocation stops pending work by default).

reassign_to.description: Active human principal that receives owned records (A.7).

DisableRequestResponse.description: `202 Accepted` body for async disable — carries the job resource id.

download_url.description:
Short-lived capability URL on this API (`GET
/message-attachments/{id}/download?token=…`) — the token expires and
the download re-checks the mailbox grant.

DuplicateStrategy.description:
How `imports.commit` treats rows marked `duplicate` at validation.
`review` (default, B.3.13) leaves them for a human — they are skipped;
`link` imports the row but attaches to the already-existing company /
email address instead of creating a new entity. Re-importing a
suppressed address under `link` therefore recreates the contact while
the suppression keeps applying (T32).

body_html.description:
Sanitized HTML (§15.1, T26): script/style/form/event handlers and
remote images stripped. `null` when the message has no HTML part.

provider_message_id.description: Provider message id as a string (B.1.1 `ProviderId`).

enabled.description:
true = engage the emergency stop (new submissions halt); false =
resume (Admin + reason + audit, A.7/task brief).

EmergencyStopResponse.description: Workspace emergency-stop state. `policy_version` is the ETag source.

ErrorCode.description:
Stable API error codes. Includes every code in source B.5 plus the generic
transport-level codes of spec §4.3. Serialization is the wire string.

EvidenceInput.description:
One evidence entry attached to a proposal (B.3.12). `source_url` must
pass the research URL policy (public http(s) only — §15.1 SSRF table).

EvidenceReviewDecision.description:
Decision kind for `POST /research-evidence/{id}/reviews` — only the two
terminal review states are reachable (pending → verified|rejected).

EvidenceType.description:
`research_evidence.evidence_type` CHECK values: a fact directly observed
at the source vs. a model inference. `inferred` never implies verified
(§13.4).

ExecuteLaunchRequest.description:
`POST /campaign-launches/{id}/execute` body — authorizes one explicit
execution of the approved frozen manifest using launch-version CAS.

ExecuteLaunchResponse.description:
Explicit campaign execution acceptance. The launch remains `approved`
until the worker activates it; authorization and activation each bump version.

q.description: Substring match on company name or domain (case-insensitive).

FreezeMessageDraftRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/message-drafts/{id}/freeze` (B.3.10): channel (+sender)
selection produces the immutable outbound snapshot.

meeting_type_id.description:
Meeting type used to mint the recipient-bound system booking URL when
the selected template requires `meeting.booking_url`.

sender_identity_id.description:
Must equal the channel's bound sender_identity_id when supplied
(fk_060 pins the sender to the channel).

tracking_requested.description:
Explicitly request recipient-bound open/click request tracking.
Workspace settings can disable tracking regardless of this value.

payload_hash.description:
SHA-256 hex of the immutable snapshot — passed back as
`expected_payload_hash` on approval-requests / submit.

can_send.description: Agent grants satisfy approved-submit ACL checks, not direct sending.

GrantResponse.description:
Grant row (B.3.2). `version` is the grant's ETag; `permission_version`
is the target principal's bumped cache-invalidation counter (§5.5).

can_send.description: Agent grants satisfy approved-submit ACL checks, not direct sending.

pending_actions_revalidation_requested.description: Pending work is revalidated against the new grant (§5.5).

ImportMapping.description:
Column mapping: `{<csv header>: <canonical field>}` where canonical
fields come from `domain::imports::CANONICAL_FIELDS`.

has_header.description: First CSV row is a header (default true).

ImportResponse.description:
`GET /imports/{id}` — progress, validation result and (for exports) the
output download descriptor.

download_url.description:
For completed exports: API path + short-lived token to fetch the
produced CSV. `null` otherwise (§15.2 — never an object key).

validation_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the validated snapshot — required on commit.

ImportStatus.description:
`import_jobs.status` CHECK values. For export jobs (mapping
`.job_kind == "export"`) `uploaded` doubles as the queued state:
`uploaded → completed | failed`.

imap_host.description: Empty until an administrator explicitly configures the IMAP host.

InvalidRowPolicy.description:
How `imports.commit` treats rows still `invalid` after validation
(B.3.13: `invalid_row_policy=skip` or `reject`).

InvitationCreatedResponse.description:
`201` response — `invite_url` embeds the one-time token and is shown
once, to copy manually (X2).

invite_url.description:
One-time invitation URL — the raw token appears only on the fresh
response, never in persisted idempotency storage (B.1.3).

JobResponse.description:
`GET /jobs/{id}` response — 진행·에러·재시도 가능 여부 (B.2).
Only safe ID/version references from `payload` are returned.

external_effect.description: kind가 외부 효과 작업인지 (§16.4; 재시도 시 reason 필수).

retry_requires_reason.description: 외부 효과 kind는 재시도 요청 시 reason + 감사가 필요하다.

retryable.description: state ∈ {dead, retry_wait} 일 때만 true. `unknown`은 절대 재시도 불가(ADR-006).

reason.description: 운영자 사유 — 외부 효과 kind는 필수, 감사 details에 기록된다.

JobState.description: `jobs.state` values, kept in sync with the DDL CHECK constraint.

JobSummaryResponse.description:
`GET /jobs` summary row. The collection omits payload/result references;
those are available only through the access-checked detail endpoint.

activation_job_id.description: Retained for status and deduplication after explicit execution.

allowed_actions.description: UI hint only; every execution is authorized again by the service.

execution_status.description: Execution of the approved manifest, separate from launch lifecycle state.

manifest_hash.description: sha256 hex (B.1.1 `Hash` wire format); absent while `building`.

company_id.description:
Accept-only merge choice: attach the accepted data to this existing
company instead of creating a new one (§13.4 — never auto-merge).

LeadProposalInput.description:
A single lead candidate inside a `POST /lead-proposals` batch (B.3.12).

`proposed_data` is a free-form object; the canonical contact shape the
accept path understands is
`proposed_data.contacts: [{name, job_title?, department?, email?}]`.
Email candidates are stored as-is — never fabricated (§13.4) — and get a
`communication_bases` row with `status='pending'` on accept, so they are
not sendable until a human review validates a basis.

evidence.description: At least one evidence entry is required (§13.4 필수 항목).

proposed_data.description: JSON object of proposed field values (e.g. industry, contacts[]).

LeadProposalResultItem.description: Per-item result of a batch create (B.3.12).

duplicate_company_ids.description:
Existing companies that look like the same entity (by domain/name).
Never auto-merged — a human decides (§13.4).

LocalCalendarConnectionRequest.description:
`POST /calendar-connections/local` — the caller connects their own
Office-owned calendar. The body is deliberately empty; no tenant or
external credential input is accepted.

duration_minutes.description:
Meeting length and booking window, so a reschedule can reuse the
booking calendar.

MarketingEligibility.description:
Send-eligibility preview for an address (B.3.4). Reason codes reuse the
stable B.5 codes (`RECIPIENT_SUPPRESSED`, `SEND_BASIS_UNVERIFIED`).

field_choices.description:
Per-field winner: `"source"` or `"target"`; fields not listed keep
the target value. Allowed keys: name, domain, website_url, industry,
country_code, lifecycle_stage, description, custom_fields,
owner_principal_id.

status.description: Always `queued` — the merge is applied by `crm.merge_companies`.

outbound_message_id.description: Present after the draft is frozen.
Present after this draft has been frozen into an immutable snapshot.

sales_campaign_id.description: Present when the draft belongs to a personalized sales campaign.

sales_target_id.description: Present when the draft belongs to a personalized sales target.

OAuthStartResponse.description:
OAuth start info: the provider authorization URL carries a signed,
expiring `state` binding this connection request.

OperationalCounts.description: 운영 안정성 카운터 (§2.4 마지막 행 — 각각 별도 모니터링).

click_request_count.description: Capability requests, not proof of a person following a link.

open_request_count.description: Capability requests, not proof of a person opening the message.

tracking_enabled.description:
False means tracking was disabled by either this freeze request or
workspace policy; zero counts alone do not imply that tracking ran.

OutboundMessageResponse.description:
`GET /api/v1/outbound-messages/{id}` (B.3.11). `delivery_status` is built
only from provider-confirmed delivery_events — `accepted` never implies
delivered/read (T34).

approval_snapshot_matches.description: Whether the latest approval was issued for this exact frozen hash.

approval_status.description: Latest request state; null means no approval request exists.

approval_valid.description:
Current decision, expiry, snapshot, and human approver permission all
remain valid for the immutable outbound snapshot.

automatic_resubmit_allowed.description: ADR-006: unknown outcomes are never resubmitted automatically.

body_text.description: Frozen body snapshot shown in the submit confirmation preview.

delivery_status.description:
unknown | accepted | delivered | bounced | complained | deferred —
provider evidence only.

from_address.description: Frozen sender identity shown in the submit confirmation preview.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 of the immutable frozen snapshot, required on submit/approval.

provider_accepted.description:
true → provider confirmed acceptance; false → definitively failed;
null → outcome not established.

thread_id.description: Mailbox-local thread containing the sent message and verified replies.

code.description: Stable failure code (B.5-style) when `passed` is false.

OutboundPreflightResponse.description:
`POST /api/v1/outbound-messages/{id}/preflight` (B.3.10). Mirrors the
B.3.7 evaluation shape; explicitly non-binding.

is_execution_authorization.description: Never `true` — policy evaluation is not an execution authorization.

PasswordChangedResponse.description: Status-only response. Password values and hashes are never echoed.

custom_fields.description: Replaces the whole custom_fields object when present.

company_id.description: Absent = keep, null = unlink from the company.

enabled.description:
Enabling requires `policy_status=allowed` + unexpired gate evidence +
provider/purpose policy (T33: zoho_mail marketing/transactional is
never enable-able).

PatchEmailTemplateRequest.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/email-templates/{id}` — metadata only; content changes go
through new template_versions (immutable).

archived.description: Set `archived` to soft-archive/unarchive the logical template.

expected_last_inbound_id.description:
Confirming a reviewed newer inbound — the re-review action after
REPLY_CONTEXT_CHANGED (T16).

oneOf.description:
Human roles only (`admin` | `manager` | `member`). Agent/system
principals keep their fixed role.

due_at.description: Absent = keep, null = clear the due date.

reason_codes.description:
B.5 code names + module-local reason codes (ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND,
ADDRESS_INVALID).

is_execution_authorization.description: Always false — preflight is never an execution authorization (B.3.7).

PrincipalListItem.description:
Admin roster reads return details; other human sessions receive only the
fields needed to choose an active owner or host.

PrincipalPickerResponse.description:
Limited active-human roster fields for assignment pickers. Non-admin
human sessions never receive user ids or permission state.

PrincipalResponse.description: Principal row as exposed over the API. `version` drives the ETag.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem detail with project extensions (B.1.2).

PublicBookingInvitee.description:
The recipient a bound booking link was issued to — only ever shown to the
holder of that recipient's own capability link.

oneOf.description:
Invited recipient for a link bound to one address (outreach links),
so the guest form can be prefilled. Absent for open links.

privacy_notice_version.description: The exact notice version the guest must acknowledge in a booking POST.

PublicLinkBookingResponse.description: Where the guest manages the booking a used-up invitation already made.

Purpose.description: Delivery purpose — equals the DDL CHECK values verbatim (§12.4).

can_approve.description: Approver authority for Admin/Manager humans and agents.

can_send.description:
Mailbox send ACL (direct submit additionally needs `mail.send`;
approved-submit needs `mail.submit_approved`).

RatioKpi.description: 비율 KPI: 분모가 0이면 `value`는 null(UI01의 N/A 표시). 분자·분모는 항상 표시.

ReadStateRequest.description:
`PUT /email-threads/{id}/read-state` (B.2 — 본인의 읽음 위치만).
Monotonic per B.1.4: the server stores `max(existing, requested)` so an
old timestamp can never erase a newer read mark.

last_read_at.description: Mark-read position; defaults to `now()` when omitted.

ReauthMailboxSample.description: 메일 계정 메타데이터만 노출 — 본문·토큰 아님 (§5.6).

reason.description: 대조(reconcile) 근거 — 필수. 감사 details에 기록된다.

ReleaseSuppressionRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/suppressions/{id}/release-requests` — evidence + reason go
to the audit entry metadata (the table has no column; integration
contract). Never a direct release (B.2).

evidence_ref.description: Required evidence pointer for the compliance review.

RenderTemplateVersionRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/template-versions/{id}/render` (B.2). Sample variables only;
system-generated URLs are injected server-side.

expected_last_inbound_id.description:
What the client believes is the latest inbound message; a mismatch is
`409 REPLY_CONTEXT_CHANGED` (B.5, T16).

ReviewBasisRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/communication-bases/{id}/reviews` — human judgment
(B.2: "valid/rejected 판단, 유효 기간"). Requires `If-Match`.

valid_until.description: Optional expiry for a `valid` decision; rejected bases keep NULL.

steps.description: Ordered immutable step definitions, sufficient to review or clone a revision.

RevokeApprovalRequest.description: `POST /approvals/{id}/revoke` body — If-Match on the request version.

not_before.description: Persisted ten-minute batch boundary. Kept on the card after reload.

oneOf.description: `None` means Mail accounts has no explicit default sender configured.

stage.description: Effective board column. Later delivery columns are server-derived.

workflow_stage.description: Last editable workflow column, retained when a send is queued.

ScheduleRulesInput.description:
Sending window/rate rules stored on the revision (B.3.6 `schedule_rules`).
Weekdays are ISO-8601 numbers (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday).

window_end.description: Local "HH:MM" window end in the revision timezone.

window_start.description: Local "HH:MM" window start in the revision timezone.

imap_host.description: Public IMAP hostname; IMAP TLS port 993 and INBOX are server-fixed.

SubmitOutboundRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/outbound-messages/{id}/submit` (B.3.10). Requires
`Idempotency-Key` and the `mail.send` scope for credential callers.

expected_payload_hash.description:
Client must resend the payload hash it expects to submit — a changed
snapshot yields SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH.

SubmitOutboundResponse.description:
B.3.10 response: `{outbound_message_id, status, job_id,
provider_accepted}` — accepted is `false` because provider acceptance is
only confirmed asynchronously.

provider_accepted.description: Always `false` at enqueue — set only after provider confirmation.

last_inbound_message_id.description: Authoritative last inbound pointer used to fence reply drafts, including timestamp ties.

my_last_read_at.description:
Caller's own read mark (`thread_read_states`, §9.3) — never another
principal's.

ThreadStatus.description: `email_threads.status` — must equal the DDL CHECK values (§12.4).

ThreadSummary.description:
One row of `GET /email-threads` (B.2). `subject`/`snippet` come from the
latest message — the SQL already filters by `can_read` grant so content
never leaks to ungranted principals (§5.4/§5.6).

snippet.description: Plain-text preview (≤200 chars) of the latest message.

unread.description: Latest inbound arrived after the caller's `thread_read_states` mark.

UnsubscribeConfirmationResponse.description:
`GET /public/v1/unsubscribe/{token}` — confirmation data only, no state
change (§11.2). Never reveals the underlying address.

status.description:
`pending_confirmation` (link not used yet) or `unsubscribed`
(already processed — same GET stays side-effect free).

stage.description:
Only `research`, `draft`, and `review` are writable. Queued,
accepted, and attention are derived from approval and outbound state.

storage_key.description: Opaque object key — knowing it grants nothing (§15.2).

upload_token.description:
Single-use-style HMAC capability binding workspace, principal, key,
media type, declared size and expiry. Passed as `?token=`.

upload_url.description: API path the client PUTs the bytes to.

UserSessionResponse.description:
Own-session metadata shown in Security settings. Never includes the
session token hash or any bearer secret.

Violation.description: Field-level violation inside a problem detail (B.1.2).

ZohoOAuthSettingsRequest.description:
`PUT /mail-accounts/oauth-settings` (Admin). The client secret is
write-only: omit it to keep the stored secret.

redirect_uri.description:
Exact callback URI registered in the Zoho API Console. Omit to use the
generated `<public origin>/api/v1/integrations/zoho/callback`.

ZohoOAuthSettingsResponse.description: Effective Zoho Mail OAuth client configuration. The secret is never returned.

configured.description: True when client ID, secret and a valid callback URI are all present.

default_redirect_uri.description: Generated default callback URI to register in the Zoho API Console.

redirect_uri.description: Callback URI currently in effect (stored, env, or generated).
